explication: APatch is an Android kernel-based root and system-patching product. Users manage root access, kernel modules (KPM), Magisk-like modules (APM), and patch installation through the Android app; the app also exposes a WebView interface. A privileged Rust command-line runtime handles boot events, module operations, and system tools. The README documents KernelPatch as the kernel core. Several app and runtime subsystems are represented from the tree and README because their implementations were not excerpted; edges are limited to documented or indexed relationships.
